blocking.checklist_item: - [ ] Guard the mcp block against redeploying an already-current target during a bot-deferral episode (e.g. skip when the live upstream already points at a container running $MCP_IMAGE:$TARGET, or track an mcp-component deployed marker), since deployed-sha is intentionally not advanced while deferred.
evidence: autodeploy.sh:500 `changed() { git -C "$MIRROR_DIR" diff --name-only "$DEPLOYED" "$TARGET" -- $1 ...; }` — gate is global DEPLOYED..TARGET
autodeploy.sh:638 `if changed "$MCP_PATHS"; then` — mcp block re-runs whenever DEPLOYED..TARGET touches MCP_PATHS
autodeploy.sh:738-739 `if [ "$bot_deferred" = 1 ]; then` / `exit 0` — deferral exits before line 786, so deployed-sha is not advanced
autodeploy.sh:786 `echo "$TARGET" > "$SHA_FILE.tmp" && mv ...` — the only place deployed-sha advances, skipped on deferral
Commit message: 'in_flight > 0 is its normal steady state under any pipelining -- so in practice ~every tick deferred', implying the mcp path re-runs on ~every tick for the whole busy window
No idempotency check: `mcp_run_new` (autodeploy.sh:691) is called unconditionally; nothing checks whether a container already runs `$MCP_IMAGE:$TARGET`
blocking.finding: During a bot-deferral episode deployed-sha is never advanced, but the mcp deploy gate `changed "$MCP_PATHS"` compares the global $DEPLOYED..$TARGET, so a shared src/rebar change re-triggers the full mcp blue-green cutover on EVERY tick the bot stays busy — with no per-component idempotency guard the mcp service is redeployed repeatedly for an already-deployed target.
scenarios: Bot busy for an extended period after a shared src/rebar change: mcp blue-green cutover fires on every ~2-minute tick, churning the {8091,A,B} port pool, repeatedly stopping/retiring the just-deployed container and flipping nginx.
